reason: The repair cell has ribosomes, and the copied instructions and amino acids are the visible ingredients for making collagen.
expectation: The cell will use the instructions and amino acids to make collagen.

effect: The repair cell used the instructions and amino acids to make collagen chains, which entered membrane spaces. The Golgi and vesicles now suggest a route for delivering them outside.
reaction: The intact RNA template makes its role clear, though its consumption in the game is a little confusing.
reason: The Golgi and vesicles are shown carrying material toward the cell boundary, so they appear to be the next part of collagen delivery.
expectation: The Golgi and vesicles will prepare and transport the collagen for release outside the cell.

effect: The collagen was released and assembled into supporting fibers outside the cell, completing the first goal. The Golgi also remains intact in the picture despite being consumed as a game item.
reaction: The three stages make the connection between cell work and tissue support clear.
reason: The local repair signals are shown reaching cells at the wound edge, suggesting they help those cells respond to the gap.

choice.with: Skin cells at the scrape’s edge

expectation: The signals will prompt the edge cells to help close the scrape.

effect: The signals prompted edge cells to divide and crawl toward the gap. The spreading cells and new supporting fibers now need to be brought into the wound.
reaction: The progression from a signal to cell movement is clear.
reason: The spreading surface cells can help close the gap in the body’s scraped skin.
expectation: The cells will spread across the scrape and help close its surface.

effect: The surface gap has closed, but deeper gaps remain. The new supporting fibers appear needed beneath it.
reaction: The cross-section makes the distinction between surface closure and deeper repair clear.
reason: The new supporting fibers can replace missing support beneath the closed surface.
expectation: The fibers will fill or reinforce the deeper gaps.

effect: The new fibers restored support beneath the closed surface and completed the goals, while the result showed that deeper remodeling continues.
reaction: The distinction between a renewed barrier and continuing repair was satisfying and clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making collagen inside the repair cell and following it through the Golgi to fibers outside was the most worthwhile passage. It connected cell activity to tissue support in a concrete sequence.

leastWorthwhile.text: The game said the copied instructions and Golgi were consumed, although the pictures showed them remaining intact. That wording was confusing.

surprise.text: Closing the surface did not mean the deeper repair was complete; the later picture showed loosely arranged collagen and ongoing remodeling.

arbitrary.text: No choice felt particularly arbitrary: the item descriptions and goals suggested each pairing.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter developed a similarly concrete connection between cell work and the body. This chapter made that relationship interesting, though its combinations were fairly predictable.
